notes.title: New Features Unlocked
notes.content:
Exciting News, Celestial Adventurers! 

Titan Revenge has unveiled cosmic wonders with the latest update! Embark on a celestial journey like never before with the introduction of two groundbreaking features:

[b]Archangel Promotion:[/b] Ascend to new heights as you unlock the celestial potential within! Harness the power of Archangels to amplify your character's prowess and redefine your cosmic destiny.

[b]Equipment Awakening:[/b] Ignite the essence of your gear! Unleash untold power as your equipment awakens, transforming into cosmic artifacts with unparalleled abilities. Arm yourself with celestial might!

Don't miss out on these cosmic revelations! Join the adventure now, unlock stage 1 in the Archangel system, and experience the next evolution in Titan Revenge.

notes.title: New Cross-Server Features Unleashed!
notes.content:
Exciting News for Titan Revenge Players!

New Cross-Server Features Unleashed!

[b]1. Archangel War[/b]
-Explore the divided territories: Temple, Sanctuary, Forbidden Land.
-Attack territories connected by roads of the same or higher level.
-Each server is aligned to a faction.
-Defeat monsters to earn points; the faction with the most points captures the territory!

[b]2. Classic Feature: Archangel Sword[/b]
-Unleash the power of the Archangel Set!
-Collect Weapon, Armor, Guardian, and Accessory Sets.
-Activate powerful Set Attributes and Skills by assembling the Set parts.
Join now and conquer the cosmic realms with these thrilling updates!
